english.title: Return to airport within 24 hours of a request to leave - Manchester Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having been requested to leave Manchester Airport by

(A)_[a constable,]_
(B)_[an airport official,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY NAME OF CONSTABLE OR OFFICIAL..), on a ground set out in byelaw 3.37 of the Manchester Airport PLC Byelaws 2024, namely **(..SPECIFY GROUND FOR REQUEST..), re-entered the airport within 24 hours thereafter without authorisation in writing from that

(C)_[constable]_
(D)_[airport official]_

or in

(E)_[his]_
(F)_[her]_

absence the Airport Company
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 2.2 and 3.38 of the Manchester Airport PLC Byelaws 2024.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
having left Manchester Airport
at the request of a PC / airport official
re-entered the airport
within the period of twenty-four hours thereafter
without authorisation in writing by the PC / airport official issuing the original request to leave
